diagnosis: WebPushUnsubscribeView allows users to unsubscribe from browser push notifications by providing a subscription_id. The view looks up PushInformation.objects.filter(id=subscription_id) without verifying that push_info.user == request.user. An attacker can enumerate subscription IDs to delete push notification registrations of other users, preventing them from receiving security and operational alerts.
